product.name: BLIXTSNABB hob
product.introText: Induction hob, IKEA 700, 78 cm: flexible zone, centre zone and two right zones that can be bridged. Touch sliders 0-9 with Booster, timer per zone, Pause, Lock. Manual AA-2198542 (simplified: the multi-flex modes and the second centre slider are not simulated). Water heating runs at 10x speed.

help: Click a touch key Click along a slider sets the level Hold On/Off 1 s, OK 3 s (lock) Click the pot, then a zone Right-drag orbit

tasks.title: Switch the hob on
tasks.text: Touch and hold On/Off (I/O, bottom row) for about 1 second.

tasks.title: Pot on the flexible zone
tasks.text: Click the pot on the worktop, then click the large flexible zone on the left.

tasks.title: Flexible zone to 7
tasks.text: Slide along the upper left keypad to power setting 7.

tasks.title: Move the pot right
tasks.text: Pick the pot up again and put it on the right rear zone. The flexible zone shows a flashing U and switches off after 30 s without a pot.

tasks.title: Bridge
tasks.text: Touch the Bridge key (right end of the upper row): both right zones now work as one.

tasks.title: Bridge to 9
tasks.text: Set the bridged zones to 9 with one of the right keypads.

tasks.title: Timer 5 minutes
tasks.text: Touch T until a right zone is selected, then press + five times.

tasks.title: Lock
tasks.text: Touch LOCK: the power settings cannot be changed, the zones keep heating.

tasks.title: Unlock and switch off
tasks.text: Touch LOCK again, then hold On/Off.
